author: Murphh
body:
When I play walls, I use this option sometimes to communicate with my teammates:
/c t  = changes chat to my team only
/c g = changes chat back to global, so everyone can see my chat

The problem is that I keep forgetting to do /c g, and I stay in team chat for a couple of games.  I'm chatting to other players on other teams and wondering why they don't hear me. :(

So...my suggestion is to have the server reset my channel to global after every game.  I'm doing gg and no one hears me!  Why I gotta be so rude...?
